name: fink-fat
desc: Tables written by the fink-fat engine (convert, streaming), fink-fat-explorer and fink-fat submit.

tables.name: public.orbit_fits
tables.comment: Orbit fits computed by fink-fat-explorer (single lineage on demand, or bulk): Gauss IOD then n-body differential correction (outfit). Append-only history, one row per fit; owned by the explorer, never truncated by a load, no FK to the trajectory tables.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Identifier of the fit.

columns.name: lineage_designation
columns.comment: Lineage fitted (branches.lineage_designation, by value).

columns.name: branch_id
columns.comment: Branch fitted (branches.branch_id, by value); NULL for rows written before per-branch fits existed.

columns.name: fitted_at
columns.comment: When the fit was stored.

columns.name: observation_ids
columns.comment: Observations submitted to the fit (observations.id), before outlier rejection.

columns.name: n_observations_used
columns.comment: Observations kept by the fit after outlier rejection.

columns.name: error_model
columns.comment: Astrometric error model used to weight the observations.

columns.name: fit_method
columns.comment: differential_correction for a converged least-squares fit; otherwise the IOD-only fallback (the bulk fit keeps the Gauss solution when the correction diverges).

columns.name: fit_params
columns.comment: Full fit parameters, as JSON (to reload a past configuration).

columns.name: reference_epoch
columns.comment: Epoch of the elements, MJD.

columns.name: semi_major_axis
columns.comment: Equinoctial a: semi-major axis, AU.

columns.name: eccentricity_sin_lon
columns.comment: Equinoctial h = e·sin(Ω + ω).

columns.name: eccentricity_cos_lon
columns.comment: Equinoctial k = e·cos(Ω + ω).

columns.name: tan_half_incl_sin_node
columns.comment: Equinoctial p = tan(i/2)·sin Ω.

columns.name: tan_half_incl_cos_node
columns.comment: Equinoctial q = tan(i/2)·cos Ω.

columns.name: mean_longitude
columns.comment: Equinoctial λ = Ω + ω + M, rad.

columns.name: covariance
columns.comment: 6×6 covariance of the equinoctial elements, row-major, 36 values.

columns.name: normalised_rms
columns.comment: Normalized RMS of the astrometric residuals.

columns.name: total_newton_iterations
columns.comment: Iterations of the differential correction.

columns.name: num_measurements
columns.comment: Scalar measurements used (two per observation).

columns.name: converged
columns.comment: Whether the differential correction converged.

columns.name: keplerian
columns.comment: Keplerian elements of the fitted orbit, as JSON.

columns.name: delta_vs_previous_fit
columns.comment: Comparison with the previous fit of the lineage, as JSON; NULL for bulk fits.

columns.name: residuals
columns.comment: Per-observation residuals, as JSON.

indexes.name: orbit_fits_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orbit_fits_pkey ON public.orbit_fits USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_orbit_fits_lineage
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_orbit_fits_lineage ON public.orbit_fits USING btree (lineage_designation, fitted_at DESC)

indexes.name: idx_orbit_fits_branch
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_orbit_fits_branch ON public.orbit_fits USING btree (branch_id, fitted_at DESC)

tables.name: public.orbit_fit_failures
tables.comment: One row per failed bulk orbit fit (Gauss IOD found no orbit), so that the homepage quality tier can tell a failed branch from one never submitted. Owned by fink-fat-explorer, append-only.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Identifier of the attempt.

columns.name: branch_id
columns.comment: Branch whose fit failed (branches.branch_id, by value).

columns.name: attempted_at
columns.comment: When the attempt failed.

indexes.name: orbit_fit_failures_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orbit_fit_failures_pkey ON public.orbit_fit_failures USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_orbit_fit_failures_branch
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_orbit_fit_failures_branch ON public.orbit_fit_failures USING btree (branch_id, attempted_at DESC)

tables.name: public.cnd_queries
tables.comment: MPC Check Near-Duplicates (CND) checks of a lineage's observations, on demand or in bulk: one row per check attempt, including those that found nothing. Owned by fink-fat-explorer, append-only.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Identifier of the check.

columns.name: lineage_designation
columns.comment: Lineage checked (branches.lineage_designation, by value).

columns.name: branch_id
columns.comment: Branch checked (branches.branch_id, by value); NULL for older rows.

columns.name: queried_at
columns.comment: When the check ran.

columns.name: time_separation_s
columns.comment: Time tolerance of the near-duplicate search, seconds.

columns.name: angle_separation_arcsec
columns.comment: Angular tolerance of the near-duplicate search, arcsec.

columns.name: hits
columns.comment: Observations with at least one MPC near-duplicate, as a JSON array of CndHit ([] when none).

indexes.name: cnd_queries_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cnd_queries_pkey ON public.cnd_queries USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_cnd_queries_lineage
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_cnd_queries_lineage ON public.cnd_queries USING btree (lineage_designation, queried_at DESC)

tables.name: public.skybot_bulk_jobs
tables.comment: One row per attempt of the explorer's bulk Skybot sweep (cross-match of every eligible observation with known objects). A partial unique index allows at most one running job.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Identifier of the job.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: running, done, failed, killed or interrupted.

columns.name: radius_arcsec
columns.comment: Search radius around each observation, arcsec.

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: When the job started.

columns.name: finished_at
columns.comment: When it ended; NULL while running.

columns.name: total_observations
columns.comment: Eligible observations in the whole dataset (population-wide progress).

columns.name: processed_observations
columns.comment: Eligible observations ever checked (resumed jobs start from the previous count).

columns.name: matched_observations
columns.comment: Of those, observations matched to a known object.

columns.name: kill_requested
columns.comment: Set by the UI to ask the running job to stop.

columns.name: error
columns.comment: Error message of a failed job.

columns.name: logs
columns.comment: Milestone log lines of the job (start, resume, kill, end).

indexes.name: skybot_bulk_jobs_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX skybot_bulk_jobs_pkey ON public.skybot_bulk_jobs USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_skybot_bulk_jobs_single_running
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_skybot_bulk_jobs_single_running ON public.skybot_bulk_jobs USING btree ((1)) WHERE (status = 'running'::text)

indexes.name: idx_skybot_bulk_jobs_started_at
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_skybot_bulk_jobs_started_at ON public.skybot_bulk_jobs USING btree (started_at DESC)

tables.name: public.skybot_obs_status
tables.comment: One row per observation ever checked by Skybot (bulk sweep or per-lineage search), upserted on obs_id: the single source of truth of Skybot results. Only written on a successful request.

columns.name: obs_id
columns.comment: Observation checked (observations.id, by value). Primary key.

columns.name: lineage_designation
columns.comment: Lineage the observation was checked for.

columns.name: branch_id
columns.comment: Branch the observation was checked for.

columns.name: checked_at
columns.comment: When it was last checked.

columns.name: radius_arcsec
columns.comment: Search radius, arcsec.

columns.name: hits
columns.comment: Known objects found, as a JSON array of SkybotHit ([] when none).

indexes.name: skybot_obs_status_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX skybot_obs_status_pkey ON public.skybot_obs_status USING btree (obs_id)

indexes.name: idx_skybot_obs_status_checked_at
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_skybot_obs_status_checked_at ON public.skybot_obs_status USING btree (checked_at)

indexes.name: idx_skybot_obs_status_lineage
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_skybot_obs_status_lineage ON public.skybot_obs_status USING btree (lineage_designation)

tables.name: public.mpc_submissions
tables.comment: Every MPC submission attempt made by fink-fat submit (ADES XML), and the source of truth for what was already submitted. Owned by submit and the explorer's submission dashboard, append-only.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Identifier of the attempt.

columns.name: lineage_designation
columns.comment: Lineage submitted (branches.lineage_designation, by value).

columns.name: branch_id
columns.comment: Branch submitted (branches.branch_id, by value).

columns.name: trk_sub
columns.comment: Tracklet identifier (ADES trkSub) sent to the MPC.

columns.name: endpoint
columns.comment: test (submit_xml_test) or production (submit_xml).

columns.name: submission_id
columns.comment: Acknowledgement id returned by the MPC; NULL if the POST failed.

columns.name: observation_ids
columns.comment: Observations submitted (observations.id, by value); GIN-indexed for the duplicate check.

columns.name: xml
columns.comment: Full ADES payload sent, for audit.

columns.name: ack_message
columns.comment: Acknowledgement message returned by the MPC.

columns.name: ac2_email
columns.comment: Contact email the MPC acknowledgement was sent to.

columns.name: submitted_at
columns.comment: When the submission was sent.

columns.name: verdict
columns.comment: pending, accepted, rejected or error; refreshed from the explorer's submission dashboard.

columns.name: verdict_checked_at
columns.comment: When the verdict was last refreshed.

columns.name: verdict_detail
columns.comment: Raw status payload behind the verdict, as JSON.

columns.name: wamo_detail
columns.comment: Per-observation processing status from MPC WAMO, as JSON (production submissions only).

columns.name: wamo_checked_at
columns.comment: When wamo_detail was last refreshed.

indexes.name: mpc_submissions_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mpc_submissions_pkey ON public.mpc_submissions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_mpc_submissions_lineage
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_mpc_submissions_lineage ON public.mpc_submissions USING btree (lineage_designation, submitted_at DESC)

indexes.name: idx_mpc_submissions_submitted_at
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_mpc_submissions_submitted_at ON public.mpc_submissions USING btree (submitted_at DESC)

indexes.name: idx_mpc_submissions_observation_ids
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_mpc_submissions_observation_ids ON public.mpc_submissions USING gin (observation_ids)

tables.name: public.observations
tables.comment: One row per alert (detection) fed to the tracker: its astrometry, photometry and epoch. Written by fink-fat convert (full reload from a parquet) and by the streaming pipeline (live, idempotent inserts). The only store of past alerts in the database, hence WAL-logged.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Alert identifier: ZTF candid or LSST diaSourceId. Primary key; referenced by branch_observations.obs_id.

columns.name: night_id
columns.comment: Observing night of the alert. Batch input: relative night index of the input parquet; streaming: MJD of the Rubin dayObs. Do not mix both in one database.

columns.name: object_id
columns.comment: Survey object identifier: ZTF objectId; for LSST, the diaSourceId as text (no persistent per-object id for unknown moving objects).

columns.name: magnitude
columns.comment: Apparent magnitude (AB for LSST).

columns.name: mag_err
columns.comment: 1-σ magnitude uncertainty.

columns.name: filter
columns.comment: Numeric filter code (LSST: u g r i z y = 0 … 5; ZTF: 1 = g, 2 = r, 3 = i).

columns.name: mpc_code_obs
columns.comment: MPC observatory code of the observer (I41 for ZTF, X05 for Rubin).

columns.name: ra
columns.comment: Right ascension, rad (ICRF).

columns.name: ra_err
columns.comment: 1-σ error on the right-ascension coordinate α (on-sky error / cos δ), rad.

columns.name: dec
columns.comment: Declination, rad (ICRF).

columns.name: dec_err
columns.comment: 1-σ declination error, rad.

columns.name: mjd_tt
columns.comment: Exposure mid-point, MJD TT.

indexes.name: observations_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observations_pkey ON public.observations USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_observations_object_id
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_observations_object_id ON public.observations USING btree (object_id)

tables.name: public.archived_trajectories
tables.comment: Closed trajectories: lineages that stopped being propagated (stale purge) but whose association history is kept as a result, with their final MAP Kalman state. Keyed by designation; only ever inserted into between full reloads.

columns.name: designation
columns.comment: Designation of the branch the trajectory was archived from. Primary key.

columns.name: lineage_id
columns.comment: Lineage the trajectory came from.

columns.name: track_ids
columns.comment: Observation ids of the trajectory (observations.id), in track order.

columns.name: cumulative_llr
columns.comment: Cumulative log-likelihood ratio at archiving time.

columns.name: n_real_updates
columns.comment: Number of real observations the trajectory associated.

columns.name: last_real_update_step
columns.comment: Night step of the last real update: where the arc actually ends.

columns.name: archived_at_step
columns.comment: Night step at which the lineage was archived.

columns.name: absolute_magnitude_estimate
columns.comment: Absolute magnitude H estimate at archiving time; NULL if never updated.

columns.name: absolute_magnitude_sample_count
columns.comment: Number of observations behind absolute_magnitude_estimate.

columns.name: ra
columns.comment: Right ascension α of the attributable state, rad (equatorial J2000).

columns.name: dec
columns.comment: Declination δ of the attributable state, rad.

columns.name: ra_dot
columns.comment: Rate of α, rad/day.

columns.name: dec_dot
columns.comment: Rate of δ, rad/day.

columns.name: rho
columns.comment: Topocentric range ρ, AU.

columns.name: rho_dot
columns.comment: Topocentric range rate, AU/day.

columns.name: covariance
columns.comment: 6×6 state covariance in attributable space (α, δ, α̇, δ̇, ρ, ρ̇), row-major, 36 values.

columns.name: epoch
columns.comment: Epoch of the state, MJD TT.

columns.name: r_obs_x
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer position x at epoch, AU (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: r_obs_y
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer position y at epoch, AU (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: r_obs_z
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer position z at epoch, AU (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: v_obs_x
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer velocity x at epoch, AU/day (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: v_obs_y
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer velocity y at epoch, AU/day (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: v_obs_z
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer velocity z at epoch, AU/day (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: universal_anomaly
columns.comment: Last universal anomaly of the two-body propagation (warm start of the next solve); NULL before the first propagation.

columns.name: kalman_gain
columns.comment: 6×2 Kalman gain of the last update, row-major, 12 values; NULL before the first update.

columns.name: nis_ema
columns.comment: Exponential moving average of the normalized innovation squared, driving the fading-memory inflation; NULL before the first update.

columns.name: dynamic_family
columns.comment: Dynamical family of the two-body orbit implied by the state (e.g. MBA, NEO, Jupiter trojan, Centaur, TNO; Unknown when the state does not convert to a bound orbit).

columns.name: semi_major_axis
columns.comment: Semi-major axis of that orbit, AU (0 when Unknown).

columns.name: eccentricity
columns.comment: Eccentricity of that orbit (0 when Unknown).

indexes.name: archived_trajectories_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX archived_trajectories_pkey ON public.archived_trajectories USING btree (designation)

tables.name: public.fink_fat_sync_state
tables.comment: Single-row record of the last nightly swap of the trajectory tables by the streaming pipeline. Empty when no sync ever completed, or after a Postgres crash (UNLOGGED, like the trajectory tables), which makes the pipeline sync again.

columns.name: singleton
columns.comment: Always TRUE: makes the table hold at most one row.

columns.name: last_synced_night
columns.comment: Last night (MJD of its dayObs) whose trajectories were swapped in.

columns.name: synced_at
columns.comment: When that swap committed.

indexes.name: fink_fat_sync_state_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fink_fat_sync_state_pkey ON public.fink_fat_sync_state USING btree (singleton)

tables.name: public.branches
tables.comment: One row per live branch of the multi-hypothesis tracker: one candidate association history of one tracked object (its lineage), with its score and precomputed observation statistics. Replaced as a whole by every load (convert, or the streaming pipeline's nightly swap).

columns.name: branch_id
columns.comment: Stable identifier of the branch, never reused (engine id counters are persisted).

columns.name: lineage_id
columns.comment: Lineage (tracked object) the branch belongs to: sibling branches share it and compete in top-B pruning.

columns.name: parent_branch_id
columns.comment: branch_id of the branch this one was spawned from.

columns.name: ancestor_at_scan_horizon
columns.comment: branch_id of the ancestor anchoring the current N-scan pruning window.

columns.name: ancestor_creation_step
columns.comment: Night step at which that ancestor was created (decides when the N-scan horizon rolls forward).

columns.name: last_real_update_step
columns.comment: Night step of the last real (non-null) observation update.

columns.name: n_real_updates
columns.comment: Number of real observations the branch associated.

columns.name: cumulative_llr
columns.comment: Cumulative log-likelihood ratio of the track against the clutter background: the branch score.

columns.name: lineage_designation
columns.comment: Human-readable, stable identifier of the lineage (shared by its branches); the key used by the explorer pages and by the explorer/submit tables.

columns.name: designation
columns.comment: Human-readable identifier unique to this branch.

columns.name: arc_length_days
columns.comment: Time span between the first and last observation of the track, days.

columns.name: n_nights
columns.comment: Number of distinct nights among the track's observations.

columns.name: median_inter_night_dt_days
columns.comment: Median gap between consecutive observed nights (each night at its earliest observation), days; NULL for a single-night track.

columns.name: n_observations
columns.comment: Number of observations in the track (as COUNT over branch_observations ⋈ observations).

columns.name: well_sampled_nights
columns.comment: Number of nights with at least two observations of the track.

indexes.name: branches_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX branches_pkey ON public.branches USING btree (branch_id)

indexes.name: idx_branches_lineage_designation
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_branches_lineage_designation ON public.branches USING btree (lineage_designation)

indexes.name: idx_branches_lineage_id
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_branches_lineage_id ON public.branches USING btree (lineage_id)

tables.name: public.kf_bank
tables.comment: One row per branch: summary of its Kalman bank (the mixture of (ρ, ρ̇) hypotheses).

columns.name: branch_id
columns.comment: The branch (FK to branches).

columns.name: n_steps
columns.comment: Number of observation steps the bank processed (drives the hypothesis-cap schedule).

columns.name: absolute_magnitude_estimate
columns.comment: Running estimate of the absolute magnitude H (with H-G phase correction); NULL before the first real observation.

columns.name: absolute_magnitude_sample_count
columns.comment: Number of observations folded into absolute_magnitude_estimate.

indexes.name: kf_bank_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX kf_bank_pkey ON public.kf_bank USING btree (branch_id)

tables.name: public.branch_observations
tables.comment: Association history of each branch: one row per observation of its track, in track order.

columns.name: branch_id
columns.comment: The branch (FK to branches).

columns.name: position
columns.comment: Rank of the observation in the track, from 0.

columns.name: obs_id
columns.comment: The observation (FK to observations.id).

indexes.name: branch_observations_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX branch_observations_pkey ON public.branch_observations USING btree (branch_id, "position")

indexes.name: idx_branch_observations_obs_id
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_branch_observations_obs_id ON public.branch_observations USING btree (obs_id)

tables.name: public.hypotheses
tables.comment: One row per hypothesis of each branch's Kalman bank: one (ρ, ρ̇) mode of the Gaussian mixture.

columns.name: hypothesis_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the row, allocated sequentially at load time (not stable across loads).

columns.name: branch_id
columns.comment: The branch (FK to branches).

columns.name: local_hyp_id
columns.comment: Stable identifier of the hypothesis within its bank.

columns.name: log_weight
columns.comment: Log of the hypothesis' posterior weight in the mixture.

columns.name: recent_log_liks
columns.comment: Log-likelihoods of the most recent updates (sliding window), used by the smoothed hypothesis pruning.

indexes.name: hypotheses_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hypotheses_pkey ON public.hypotheses USING btree (hypothesis_id)

indexes.name: idx_hypotheses_branch_log_weight
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_hypotheses_branch_log_weight ON public.hypotheses USING btree (branch_id, log_weight DESC)

tables.name: public.kf_state
tables.comment: One row per hypothesis: its Kalman state in attributable coordinates (α, δ, α̇, δ̇, ρ, ρ̇), covariance and the dynamical family of the implied orbit.

columns.name: hypothesis_id
columns.comment: The hypothesis (FK to hypotheses).

columns.name: ra
columns.comment: Right ascension α of the attributable state, rad (equatorial J2000).

columns.name: dec
columns.comment: Declination δ of the attributable state, rad.

columns.name: ra_dot
columns.comment: Rate of α, rad/day.

columns.name: dec_dot
columns.comment: Rate of δ, rad/day.

columns.name: rho
columns.comment: Topocentric range ρ, AU.

columns.name: rho_dot
columns.comment: Topocentric range rate, AU/day.

columns.name: covariance
columns.comment: 6×6 state covariance in attributable space (α, δ, α̇, δ̇, ρ, ρ̇), row-major, 36 values.

columns.name: epoch
columns.comment: Epoch of the state, MJD TT.

columns.name: r_obs_x
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer position x at epoch, AU (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: r_obs_y
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer position y at epoch, AU (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: r_obs_z
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer position z at epoch, AU (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: v_obs_x
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer velocity x at epoch, AU/day (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: v_obs_y
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer velocity y at epoch, AU/day (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: v_obs_z
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer velocity z at epoch, AU/day (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: universal_anomaly
columns.comment: Last universal anomaly of the two-body propagation (warm start of the next solve); NULL before the first propagation.

columns.name: kalman_gain
columns.comment: 6×2 Kalman gain of the last update, row-major, 12 values; NULL before the first update.

columns.name: nis_ema
columns.comment: Exponential moving average of the normalized innovation squared, driving the fading-memory inflation; NULL before the first update.

columns.name: dynamic_family
columns.comment: Dynamical family of the two-body orbit implied by the state (e.g. MBA, NEO, Jupiter trojan, Centaur, TNO; Unknown when the state does not convert to a bound orbit).

columns.name: semi_major_axis
columns.comment: Semi-major axis of that orbit, AU (0 when Unknown).

columns.name: eccentricity
columns.comment: Eccentricity of that orbit (0 when Unknown).

indexes.name: kf_state_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX kf_state_pkey ON public.kf_state USING btree (hypothesis_id)

columns.name: rho_dot

columns.name: epoch

columns.name: r_obs_x
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer position x at epoch, AU (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: r_obs_y

columns.name: r_obs_z

columns.name: v_obs_x
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer velocity x at epoch, AU/day (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: v_obs_y
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer velocity y at epoch, AU/day (ecliptic J2000).

columns.name: v_obs_z
columns.comment: Heliocentric observer velocity z at epoch, AU/day (ecliptic J2000).

indexes.name: branch_best_state_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX branch_best_state_pkey ON public.branch_best_state USING btree (branch_id)
